#include <iostream>
#include <vector>
#include <unordered_map>
#include <cmath>
using namespace std;

vector<int> generate_primes(int limit) {
    vector<int> primes;
    for (int candidate_num = 2; candidate_num < limit; ++candidate_num) {
        bool is_prime_flag = true;
        for (int prime_check : primes) {
            if (prime_check * prime_check > candidate_num) {
                break;
            }
            if (candidate_num % prime_check == 0) {
                is_prime_flag = false;
                break;
            }
        }
        if (is_prime_flag) {
            primes.push_back(candidate_num);
        }
    }
    return primes;
}

unordered_map<long long, int> factorization(long long n, const vector<int>& primes) {
    unordered_map<long long, int> factors_dict;
    for (int prime : primes) {
        if ((long long)prime * prime > n) {
            break;
        }
        if (n % prime == 0) {
            int count = 0;
            while (n % prime == 0) {
                n /= prime;
                ++count;
            }
            factors_dict[prime] = count;
        }
    }
    if (n > 1) {
        factors_dict[n] = 1;
    }
    return factors_dict;
}

vector<long long> generate_all_factors(long long n, const unordered_map<long long, int>& prime_factors) {
    vector<long long> result_factors = {1};
    for (const auto& pf : prime_factors) {
        long long prime = pf.first;
        int exp_count = pf.second;
        vector<long long> new_factors;
        for (long long val : result_factors) {
            for (int exp = 0; exp <= exp_count; ++exp) {
                long long new_val = val;
                for (int e = 0; e < exp; ++e) {
                    new_val *= prime;
                }
                new_factors.push_back(new_val);
            }
        }
        result_factors = new_factors;
    }
    return result_factors;
}

long long calculate_f(int n, int m, const vector<int>& primes) {
    unordered_map<int, long long> f;
    f[0] = 0;
    f[1] = 1;
    f[2] = 2;
    for (int i = 3; i <= n; ++i) {
        f[i] = 2 * f[i - 1];
        auto prime_factors = factorization(i, primes);
        vector<long long> all_divisors = generate_all_factors(i, prime_factors);
        for (long long divisor : all_divisors) {
            if (divisor >= 2 && divisor <= i) {
                long long quotient = i / divisor;
                long long prev1 = (i - 1) / divisor;
                f[i] = (f[i] + f[quotient] - f[prev1]) % m;
            }
        }
        f[i] %= m;
    }
    return f[n];
}

int main() {
    int x_input, y_input;
    cin >> x_input >> y_input;
    vector<int> primes = generate_primes(6000);
    cout << calculate_f(x_input, y_input, primes) << "\n";
    return 0;
}
